title: Hybrid FP8/INT8 profile selector with warm-start calibration and noise-injection safety runbook for Hopper
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Enable a robust FP8 enablement path on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2) that combines a hybrid profile selector (choosing per-model or per-batch FP8 vs INT8 paths) with a warm-start calibration flow and targeted stability mitigations. This ticket designs the selector heuristics, the warm-start (seeded mini-batch calibration) approach, synthetic noise-injection tests to exercise worst-case activations, and an operator-facing runbook for safe progressive rollout. Background: prior FP8 activations show rare but impactful outlier-driven regressions in e4m3 for some model families. Rather than an all-or-nothing activation, this work creates a staged enablement that can fall back to INT8 or higher-precision variants automatically when telemetry indicates instability. Scope: selector logic, calibration warm-start service, synthetic stress harness, CI evals, telemetry/alerting, canary rollout plan, and operator runbook. Out of scope: retraining/model changes and new quantization kernels (those are separate vendor/infra items).
acceptance_criteria: Hybrid selector implemented in runtime and exposed as config flag (fp8_hybrid_selector=true)
Warm-start calibration reduces initial activation variance by >= 30% on golden test set compared to cold calibration
Synthetic noise-injection suite triggers deterministic fallback for at least 3 known failure seeds

End-to-end golden-seed evals show generation-quality regression <= 0.8% average token-level perplexity across three model families (decoder-only, encoder-decoder, instruction-tuned chat) when using selected FP8 paths
Automated CI gate that runs golden-seed evaluations and blocks merges if regression thresholds exceeded
Canary policy in Console to gradually ramp traffic: 0% -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automatic rollback on telemetry gates
Operator runbook created and linked with step-by-step rollback and mitigation guidance
Telemetry dashboards include the new metrics and Grafana alerts; alert runbook tested in staging
implementation_notes: Selector design: per-model metadata and per-batch heuristics. Start with model-tag-driven default (opt-in) and add per-batch peak-activation checks to trigger INT8 fallback.
Warm-start calibration: seed with 128 representative short sequences (golden-seed) to derive initial FP8 scaling factors before accepting production traffic.
Activation smoothing: add per-layer moving-median clipping during warm-start to avoid single-sample outliers dominating scale selection.
Hybrid fallback paths: runtime must support seamless fallback to INT8 and a 'degraded-fp8' variant that uses conservative scaling for a subset of layers.
CI: add synthetic noise-injection job that inserts controlled 8-bit saturation noise and measures model outputs against golden-seed baseline
Performance: ensure selector adds < 0.8ms median overhead to request path; measure in benchmark harness
Compatibility: maintain same API surface; this change is internal to the runtime and config-driven for Dedicated/Private deployments
test_plan: Unit tests for selector heuristics and fallback decision logic
Integration tests in staging with small cluster of Hopper E4/E5 nodes using representative models
Golden-seed regression suite across 3 model families (report stored in Drive) - run nightly
Synthetic noise-injection stress tests that vary activation magnitudes and frequency
A/B evaluation: compare FP8-hybrid on canary vs control (INT8) with automatic statistical significance checks
Chaos test: terminate a subset of calibration service pods during warm-start to validate idempotency and retry logic
Load test: ensure autoscaling and batching behavior unchanged under hybrid selector
telemetry_requirements: New metrics: fp8_selector_decision{model,region,decision}, fp8_warmstart_variance_reduction, fp8_activation_outlier_rate, fp8_fallback_count, fp8_per_layer_clip_rate
Alert on: fp8_fallback_count > 5% of requests for 10m OR fp8_activation_outlier_rate > 0.1% for 5m
Dashboards: per-model FP8 stability panel; per-region fallback heatmap; warm-start success rate over time
Log correlation: capture seed-id, model version, node-id, kernel-version in each selector decision event
Retention: keep selector decision traces for 30d for postmortem and auditing
runbook: Pre-rollout checklist: ensure staging canary passed golden-seed suite and noise-injection jobs (status in Confluence)
Step 1 (canary 1%): enable fp8_hybrid_selector=true for canary group with warm-start=true; monitor for 15m
Step 2 (gating): if fp8_fallback_count > 0.5% OR activation_outlier_rate triggers alert, pause rollout and gather selector traces
Step 3 (ramp): move to 10% then 50% if all gates clear for 60m at each stage
Rollback: toggle fp8_hybrid_selector=false or set model config to forced-int8; notify on-call and open incident per standard SRE process
Post-incident: collect warm-start artifact (seed_id), run extended golden-seed evaluation and attach to incident ticket
operator_notes: Warm-start artifacts stored under seed_id namespace in object store; can replay warm-start for debugging
If rollback invoked, snapshot telemetry and export for the model version for at least 7 days
For Private deployments without telemetry forwarding, provide a CLI to run local golden-seed suite and produce a compact report
Escalation: contact quantization-research@redwood.ai and runtime-ops@redwood.ai when unexplained regressions persist after rollback
